summary: Comprehensive testing of the new plan-baked discount feature on Fee Plans (Admin) and Parent Pay portal. Backend pytest 10/11 passed (1 skipped only because parent.gn20250001 has empty linked_student_ids in current seed). Frontend end-to-end validated: admin creates a Fee Plan with plan-level %, yearly flat, and month-specific discounts; live preview computes gross/discount/net/save correctly (₹12,000 → ₹9,600, 20% saved; April ₹616.67 vs May ₹816.67); save persists; edit dialog reopens with all discount fields pre-filled. Parent portal shows 'You saved ₹3,600.00' banner and Pay Full (Annual) tab displays 'Plan discount -₹3,600' and reduced Total Payable. Old backend_test.py (root) untouched.

minor.issue: parent.gn20250001@stanvard.school has empty linked_student_ids (0 parents in DB have linked children). Not a code bug but blocks native parent-side pytest of fee-schedule without pre-linking. Worked around by PATCH-linking a student for the UI test.

action_items: (Optional/seed) Consider seeding parent.gn20250001 with linked_student_ids so parent portal tests do not require manual linking.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_plan_discount_breakdown and _validate_plan_discounts are well-factored; ordering (plan lump -> yearly -> month) matches doc and matches UI preview.
GET /api/fees/plans returns pre-existing plans without discount fields unchanged (backward-compat verified).
student_fee_schedule correctly aggregates plan-baked discounts into you_saved / plan_discount_total; per-month schedule reflects month-specific discounts.
Validation returns 400 for percent>100, negative value, month out of range (all confirmed).
seed_data_creation: Created (and cleaned up) TEST_UI3 fee plan with plan-percent 10%, yearly flat ₹1000, April flat ₹200; assigned it to GN-2025-0001, linked to parent.gn20250001 for the portal UI test, then reverted (deleted plan+assignment, unset parent.linked_student_ids).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All plan-baked discount CRUD, validation, math (breakdown), backward compatibility, student fee-schedule integration, and parent portal rendering verified. Regression: student-level ad-hoc discount + Owner approval flow was NOT re-executed here as no fix was made; existing backend_test.py at /app/backend/backend_test.py covers legacy paths. If parent-portal pytest needs to run non-skipped, PATCH parent.gn20250001.linked_student_ids to include a student that has a plan-discount assignment.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found in the new discount feature.
